ops.text: Plan-mode harness misfire: both Plan subagents this session were pointed at auto-generated plan files under ~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-16/plans/ and the Write tool refused each with "file already written this session" while Read confirmed the file did not exist on disk; both agents had to smuggle their full plans back through their final message instead. The misfiring guard wastes a write attempt per agent and forces oversized final messages that defeat the point of the plan-file channel.
